name: Studyria
description: Studyria is an Assam-focused comprehensive educational web application built for candidates preparing for ADRE, APSC, Assam Police, and TET examinations. It provides curated PDFs, previous year question papers (PYQs), interactive quizzes, full mock tests, subject-wise MCQs, daily current affairs, and career vacancy alerts in one unified portal.
shortDescription: Assam-focused study app for ADRE, APSC, Assam Police & TET with PDFs, PYQs, quizzes, mock tests, MCQs, current affairs and career updates.
features: ADRE, APSC, Assam Police, and TET specialized exam syllabus prep
Curated study materials, downloadable PDFs, and previous years question papers (PYQs)
Interactive timed mock tests, chapter-wise MCQs, and real-time score tracking
Daily Assam & Northeast current affairs digest and syllabus-focused notes
Instant career announcements and government recruitment notification updates
releaseNotes: v2.0.0: Full launch with ADRE Grade III & IV mock tests and offline PDF prep.
changelog: v2.0.0: Added interactive quizzes, full-length mock tests, and latest current affairs syllabus.

name: PDFMiniFly
description: Private PDF tools designed to edit, convert, organize and protect documents directly inside the browser. No cloud uploads. No account required. All files are processed locally using your device's memory for maximum speed and complete data privacy.
shortDescription: Private PDF Tools. Powerful. Fast. Local.
features: Local-first document processing with zero cloud uploads
Merge, split, compress, and reorder PDF pages in real time
Protect sensitive documents with client-side password encryption
Works 100% offline once opened or installed as a PWA
Zero account required, no tracking, completely private
releaseNotes: Initial release with full offline support and local client-side PDF tools
changelog: v1.0.0: Initial public release of PDFMiniFly PWA workspace

name: LifeSync
description: LifeSync is an AppMintly Original productivity application built with clean focus mode, offline synchronization, timeline planning, and customizable habit rings. Designed for people who desire deep clarity without distracting clutter.
shortDescription: All-in-one minimal planner, habit tracker, and daily priority organizer.
features: Zero-latency offline local storage support
Intuitive 3-tier task priority system
Daily habit streak calendar and momentum rings
Distraction-free focus timer with ambient white noise
Markdown-ready journal and meeting note capture
releaseNotes: Added smart keyboard shortcuts and quick command palette
Improved offline synchronization queue
changelog: v2.4.0: Added smart keyboard shortcuts and quick command palette
v2.3.1: Improved offline synchronization queue
v2.2.0: Introduced dark paper theme with custom accent swatches

name: PixelForge Studio
description: PixelForge Studio is an original lightweight creative toolkit engineered for developers, designers, and creators who need fast, unbloated asset creation. Manipulate paths, optimize SVGs, generate CSS icons, and resize graphics entirely in the browser with zero cloud latency.
shortDescription: In-browser vector and raster graphics editor with SVG batch export.
features: Real-time SVG vector manipulation & path smoothing
Lossless image compressor with live side-by-side preview
Color palette generator with WCAG contrast ratio scoring
Installable web app that functions completely offline
Export to SVG, PNG, WebP, and raw React component JSX
releaseNotes: Added WebP 2.0 compression engine
Enhanced path boolean union algorithms
changelog: v1.8.2: Added WebP 2.0 compression engine
v1.7.0: Introduced layer blend modes and path boolean union

name: VaultGuard APK
description: VaultGuard is an open, client-side Android application providing military-grade AES-256 GCM encrypted storage for personal passwords, API tokens, and time-based one-time passcodes (TOTP). No servers, no tracking, and no external telemetry.
shortDescription: Zero-knowledge Android encrypted vault for credentials and 2FA tokens.
features: AES-256-GCM hardware-backed keystore integration
Built-in QR scanner for RFC-6238 TOTP two-factor codes
Biometric fingerprint & face unlock with anti-tamper lock
Encrypted manual backup import/export (JSON format)
100% offline runtime with zero network permissions
releaseNotes: Android 15 compatibility & Material You dynamic colors
Hardened memory clearing during background transition
changelog: v3.1.0: Android 15 compatibility & Material You dynamic colors
v3.0.4: Hardened memory clearing during background transition

name: RetroBlast 84
description: RetroBlast 84 is an adrenaline-fueled retro arcade shooter built with WebGL and Web Audio. Blast through neon asteroid belts, collect plasma shields, and master responsive touch and keyboard controls in your browser.
shortDescription: Fast-paced synthwave space shooter running at a silky 60 FPS.
features: 60 FPS hardware accelerated WebGL canvas rendering
Dynamic chiptune soundtrack with reactive bass pulses
Gamepad API support for Xbox, PlayStation & 8BitDo controllers
Local high-score leaderboard stored in browser storage
Zero microtransactions, pure arcade gameplay
releaseNotes: Touch-joystick responsiveness tuning
Optimized sprite particle pooling
changelog: v1.4.2: Added touch-joystick responsiveness tuning
v1.3.0: Introduced Boss Rush chapter 3

name: CodeNova Web IDE
description: CodeNova is a browser-based developer playground with instantaneous live preview, syntax highlighting, formatting, and offline compilation. Perfect for prototyping ideas, testing algorithms, and sharing code snippets.
shortDescription: Instant sandbox code editor for TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Markdown.
features: Live reload preview pane with console logger
Monaco-powered editing with multi-cursor support
One-click format with Prettier integration
Export project to single zip bundle or standalone HTML
Installable web app for offline development
releaseNotes: Support for Tailwind CSS runtime preview
Monaco editor core update
changelog: v2.1.0: Support for Tailwind CSS runtime preview
v2.0.0: Complete overhaul with Monaco core

name: Zenith Finance
description: Zenith Finance keeps all your sensitive financial records on your own device. Categorize monthly spending, monitor recurrent recurring bills, and calculate savings targets without linking sensitive bank credentials to third-party data brokers.
shortDescription: Private personal expense log, subscription manager, and budget tracker.
features: 100% private local device storage (no server transmission)
Smart recurring subscription renewal alarms
Interactive spending category breakdown graphs
CSV export & JSON encrypted migration format
Multi-currency support with custom exchange rates
releaseNotes: Added quarterly tax deduction category filter
Optimized offline currency table
changelog: v1.2.4: Added quarterly tax deduction category filter
v1.1.0: Introduced dark mode and export to spreadsheet

name: ChronoPulse Interval Timer
description: ChronoPulse is an Android APK engineered for athletic training, high-intensity workouts, boxing rounds, and stretching routines. High-contrast display, vibration cue patterns, and background audio ducking keep you in the zone.
shortDescription: Customizable HIIT, Tabata, and athletic circuit timer for Android.
features: Custom interval sequences (Warmup, Work, Rest, Cool-down)
Haptic feedback and custom audio whistle signals
Keeps screen awake during active exercise cycles
Works in background with lock screen notification widgets
Completely ad-free and tracking-free
releaseNotes: Added volume boost for noisy gym environments
Refined Tabata countdown chimes
changelog: v2.0.1: Added volume boost for gym environments
v2.0.0: Rebuilt with modern Jetpack Compose interface

name: MindFlow Notes
description: MindFlow Notes is an intuitive thought-mapping and note-taking environment. Create linked ideas using [[wiki-links]], visualize your concepts with an interactive graph view, and maintain total ownership of plain Markdown text files.
shortDescription: Local-first Markdown knowledge base with interconnected bi-directional links.
features: Bi-directional page linking using [[brackets]]
Interactive force-directed idea graph visualizer
LaTeX math equation rendering via KaTeX
Instant search across thousands of thoughts in milliseconds
Export to pure .md zip archive anytime
releaseNotes: Added interactive tag filtering in Graph View
Speed improvements for document rendering
changelog: v1.6.0: Added interactive tag filtering in Graph View
v1.5.2: Speed improvements for document rendering

name: SoundForge Beat Drummer
description: A Web Audio groovebox right in your browser. Craft punchy beats, layer 808s, tune hi-hats, adjust swing tempo, and record loops to high-fidelity WAV audio files with zero installation needed.
shortDescription: 16-step polyphonic rhythm sequencer with vintage drum samples.
features: 16-step grid sequencer with pattern bank storage
8 sample tracks with pitch, decay, and filter controls
Real-time master distortion and tape saturation algorithms
MIDI keyboard connection via Web MIDI API
Export audio patterns directly to stereo 48kHz WAV
releaseNotes: Added Web MIDI keyboard input triggers
Analog delay effect and swing groove knob
changelog: v1.2.0: Added Web MIDI keyboard input triggers
v1.1.0: Added analog delay effect and swing groove knob

name: AppMintly Developer Hub
description: The official developer guide for AppMintly. Learn how to format application manifests, configure offline service workers, produce clean APK builds, and submit listings to the AppMintly content registry.
shortDescription: Official documentation, guidelines, and application manifest patterns for AppMintly.
features: Web app manifest best practices and generator
APK packaging recommendations for Android distribution
Interactive schema tester for /data/apps.json records
Offline documentation support via service worker
releaseNotes: Initial public documentation release
changelog: v1.0.0: Initial public documentation release
